mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen was most worthwhile because the ATP cycle connected fuel and oxygen to the continuing work of the muscle fibers.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the rear tendons felt somewhat repetitive after making the front group, though it completed the pair.

surprise.text: The wrapping’s arrows showed how individual cell pulls combine into a larger pull along the bundle.

arbitrary.text: Choosing the front tendons first felt arbitrary: both tendon options were offered and I had no clear reason to prefer one.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see how the two muscle groups attach to bones and move a joint. The progression from cellular energy to muscle pulls has held my interest.
